title: test(imap): unit tests for NAMESPACE handler
description:
Write unit tests for the NAMESPACE command handler. Expected values are derived from RFC 2342 §5, not from the implementation.

Tests to write:
1. handle_namespace_returns_correct_structure: call handle_namespace(); assert the result is Data::Namespace with personal=[Namespace{prefix="", delimiter='.'}], other=[], shared=[]; verify by inspecting the Data::Namespace fields directly.
2. handle_namespace_wire_encoding: encode the Data::Namespace result using imap-codec; assert wire bytes equal b"* NAMESPACE ((\"\" \".\")) NIL NIL\r\n" (RFC 2342 §5 example for single personal namespace with dot delimiter).
3. namespace_rejected_in_not_authenticated: confirm the dispatch arm returns NO in NotAuthenticated state (test at dispatch level).

Oracle: RFC 2342 §5 gives the exact wire format; the example exchange in the RFC is the expected output.

Acceptance: cargo test -p stoa-imap passes with all 3 tests green.
